CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.audit_balance_consistency(p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, asset_symbol text, issue_type text, recorded_balance numeric, expected_balance numeric, discrepancy numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH computed AS (
        SELECT
            t.user_id,
            t.asset_symbol,
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN t.type IN (
                        'deposit', 'staking_reward', 'unstake_completed', 'unstake',
                        'instant_unstake', 'game_win', 'referral_bonus', 'cashback', 'refund',
                        'dividend_payment', 'lending_reward', 'balance_adjustment',
                        'loan_borrowed', 'loan_collateral_release'
                    ) THEN t.amount
                    WHEN t.type IN (
                        'withdrawal', 'staking', 'staking_lock', 'stake', 'game_bet',
                        'wakati_purchase', 'fee', 'platform_fee', 'burn', 'airtime_purchase',
                        'admin_reclaim',
                        'loan_collateral_lock', 'loan_repaid', 'loan_liquidated'
                    ) THEN -t.amount
                    WHEN t.type = 'swap_debit'   THEN -t.amount
                    WHEN t.type = 'swap_credit'  THEN  t.amount
                    WHEN t.type = 'p2p_transfer' THEN
                        CASE WHEN t.amount > 0 THEN t.amount ELSE -ABS(t.amount) END
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) AS computed_available
        FROM public.transactions t
        WHERE t.status = 'completed'
          AND (p_user_id IS NULL OR t.user_id = p_user_id)
        GROUP BY t.user_id, t.asset_symbol
    )
    SELECT
        ub.user_id,
        ub.asset_symbol,
        'balance_mismatch'::text                            AS issue_type,
        ROUND(ub.available_balance, 8)                      AS recorded_balance,
        ROUND(COALESCE(c.computed_available, 0), 8)         AS expected_balance,
        ROUND(ub.available_balance - COALESCE(c.computed_available, 0), 8) AS discrepancy
    FROM public.user_balances ub
    LEFT JOIN computed c
           ON c.user_id = ub.user_id AND c.asset_symbol = ub.asset_symbol
    WHERE ABS(ub.available_balance - COALESCE(c.computed_available, 0)) > 0.00000001
      AND (p_user_id IS NULL OR ub.user_id = p_user_id)
    ORDER BY ABS(ub.available_balance - COALESCE(c.computed_available, 0)) DESC;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.audit_platform_asset_balance(p_asset_symbol text)
 RETURNS TABLE(asset text, calc_balance numeric, recorded_balance numeric, diff numeric, net_position numeric, is_balanced boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH user_sum AS (
        SELECT
            COALESCE(SUM(available_balance), 0) AS total_available,
            COALESCE(SUM(staking_balance), 0)   AS total_staking
        FROM user_balances
        WHERE asset_symbol = p_asset_symbol
    ),
    metrics AS (
        SELECT
            sam.total_user_balance,
            sam.net_position AS m_net_position
        FROM supported_assets_metrics sam
        WHERE sam.asset_symbol = p_asset_symbol
    )
    SELECT
        p_asset_symbol,
        (us.total_available + us.total_staking),
        m.total_user_balance,
        (us.total_available + us.total_staking) - m.total_user_balance,
        m.m_net_position,
        ABS((us.total_available + us.total_staking) - m.total_user_balance) < 0.00000001
    FROM user_sum us, metrics m;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.collect_fee_to_platform(p_asset_symbol text, p_amount numeric, p_fee_type text, p_source_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_source_transaction_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_fee_id uuid;
    v_asset_exists boolean;
    v_balance_after numeric;
    v_balance_before numeric;
BEGIN
    -- Validation des paramètres
    IF p_amount <= 0 THEN
        RAISE WARNING 'collect_fee_to_platform: Montant invalide (%)', p_amount;
        RETURN NULL;
    END IF;

    -- Vérifier que l'asset existe
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM supported_assets WHERE symbol = p_asset_symbol AND is_active = true
    ) INTO v_asset_exists;

    IF NOT v_asset_exists THEN
        RAISE WARNING 'collect_fee_to_platform: Asset % non trouvé ou inactif', p_asset_symbol;
        RETURN NULL;
    END IF;

    -- ================================================
    -- 1. Insérer dans platform_fees
    -- ================================================
    INSERT INTO public.platform_fees (
        asset_symbol,
        amount,
        fee_type,
        source_user_id,
        source_transaction_id,
        collected_at
    ) VALUES (
        p_asset_symbol,
        p_amount,
        p_fee_type,
        p_source_user_id,
        p_source_transaction_id,
        NOW()
    ) RETURNING id INTO v_fee_id;

    -- ================================================
    -- 1.bis. Crediter le wallet de tresorerie (le vrai solde spendable)
    -- ================================================
    INSERT INTO public.treasury_wallets (asset_symbol, balance, total_collected)
    VALUES (p_asset_symbol, p_amount, p_amount)
    ON CONFLICT (asset_symbol) DO UPDATE SET
        balance = treasury_wallets.balance + p_amount,
        total_collected = treasury_wallets.total_collected + p_amount,
        updated_at = now()
    RETURNING balance, balance - p_amount INTO v_balance_after, v_balance_before;

    INSERT INTO public.treasury_ledger (
        asset_symbol, entry_type, amount, balance_before, balance_after,
        source_transaction_id, source_fee_id, reason
    ) VALUES (
        p_asset_symbol, 'fee_credit', p_amount, v_balance_before, v_balance_after,
        p_source_transaction_id, v_fee_id, p_fee_type
    );

    -- ================================================
    -- 2. Mettre à jour les métriques dans supported_assets_metrics
    -- ================================================
    
    -- Mise à jour des métriques existantes
    UPDATE public.supported_assets_metrics
    SET 
        total_fees_collected = COALESCE(total_fees_collected, 0) + p_amount,
        last_updated = NOW()
    WHERE asset_symbol = p_asset_symbol;

    -- Mise à jour spécifique selon le type de frais
    CASE p_fee_type
        WHEN 'swap_fee' THEN
            UPDATE public.supported_assets_metrics
            SET total_swap_fees_collected = COALESCE(total_swap_fees_collected, 0) + p_amount
            WHERE asset_symbol = p_asset_symbol;
            
        WHEN 'p2p_fee' THEN
            UPDATE public.supported_assets_metrics
            SET total_p2p_fees_collected = COALESCE(total_p2p_fees_collected, 0) + p_amount
            WHERE asset_symbol = p_asset_symbol;
            
        WHEN 'withdraw_fee' THEN
            UPDATE public.supported_assets_metrics
            SET total_withdraw_fees_collected = COALESCE(total_withdraw_fees_collected, 0) + p_amount
            WHERE asset_symbol = p_asset_symbol;
            
        WHEN 'unstake_fee' THEN
            UPDATE public.supported_assets_metrics
            SET total_fees_collected = COALESCE(total_fees_collected, 0) + p_amount
            WHERE asset_symbol = p_asset_symbol;
            
        WHEN 'early_unstake_penalty' THEN
            UPDATE public.supported_assets_metrics
            SET total_fees_collected = COALESCE(total_fees_collected, 0) + p_amount
            WHERE asset_symbol = p_asset_symbol;
            
        ELSE
            -- Autres types de frais (génériques)
            UPDATE public.supported_assets_metrics
            SET total_fees_collected = COALESCE(total_fees_collected, 0) + p_amount
            WHERE asset_symbol = p_asset_symbol;
    END CASE;

    -- Si l'asset n'a pas encore de métriques, les créer
    INSERT INTO public.supported_assets_metrics (
        asset_symbol,
        total_fees_collected,
        total_swap_fees_collected,
        total_p2p_fees_collected,
        total_withdraw_fees_collected,
        total_deposited,
        total_withdrawn,
        total_staked,
        total_user_balance,
        net_position,
        should_be_in_custody,
        last_updated
    )
    SELECT 
        p_asset_symbol,
        p_amount,
        CASE WHEN p_fee_type = 'swap_fee' THEN p_amount ELSE 0 END,
        CASE WHEN p_fee_type = 'p2p_fee' THEN p_amount ELSE 0 END,
        CASE WHEN p_fee_type = 'withdraw_fee' THEN p_amount ELSE 0 END,
        0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0,
        NOW()
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.supported_assets_metrics 
        WHERE asset_symbol = p_asset_symbol
    );

    -- Log pour le débogage
    RAISE NOTICE '✅ Frais collecté: % % (type: %, tx: %)', 
        p_amount, p_asset_symbol, p_fee_type, p_source_transaction_id;

    RETURN v_fee_id;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        RAISE WARNING 'collect_fee_to_platform: Erreur - %', SQLERRM;
        RETURN NULL;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_accrue_loan_interest()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_count int;
BEGIN
  WITH updated AS (
    UPDATE loans
    SET accrued_interest = accrued_interest +
          principal_amount * (apr_rate_snapshot / 100) *
          (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - last_interest_accrual_at)) / (365 * 86400)),
        last_interest_accrual_at = now()
    WHERE status = 'active'
    RETURNING id
  )
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_count FROM updated;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'loans_updated', v_count);
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_get_prediction_state()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user_id   uuid := auth.uid();
  v_active    jsonb;
  v_stats     jsonb;
  v_config    jsonb;
  v_balance   numeric;
  v_bets_today int;
  v_history   jsonb;
BEGIN
  -- Config
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'asset_symbol',    asset_symbol,
    'asset_name',      asset_name,
    'bet_amount',      bet_amount,
    'bet_mode',        bet_mode,
    'bet_min',         bet_min,
    'bet_max',         bet_max,
    'win_multiplier',  win_multiplier,
    'duration_seconds',duration_seconds,
    'max_bets_per_day',max_bets_per_day,
    'cooldown_seconds',cooldown_seconds,
    'currency_symbol', currency_symbol,
    'is_active',       is_active
  ) INTO v_config FROM prediction_config WHERE id = 1;

  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('config', v_config);
  END IF;

  -- Solde disponible
  SELECT available_balance INTO v_balance
  FROM user_balances WHERE user_id = v_user_id AND asset_symbol = (SELECT currency_symbol FROM prediction_config WHERE id = 1);

  -- Paris du jour
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_bets_today
  FROM prediction_bets
  WHERE user_id = v_user_id AND bet_at >= CURRENT_DATE AND status != 'cancelled';

  -- Pari actif en cours
  SELECT to_jsonb(pb.*) INTO v_active
  FROM prediction_bets pb
  WHERE user_id = v_user_id AND status = 'pending'
  ORDER BY bet_at DESC LIMIT 1;

  -- Stats utilisateur
  SELECT to_jsonb(s.*) INTO v_stats
  FROM prediction_user_stats s
  WHERE user_id = v_user_id;

  -- Historique 10 derniers paris
  SELECT jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'id',                  id,
      'direction',           direction,
      'bet_amount',          bet_amount,
      'status',              status,
      'price_at_bet',        price_at_bet,
      'price_at_resolution', price_at_resolution,
      'profit_amount',       profit_amount,
      'bet_at',              bet_at,
      'resolved_at',         resolved_at
    ) ORDER BY bet_at DESC
  ) INTO v_history
  FROM (
    SELECT * FROM prediction_bets
    WHERE user_id = v_user_id AND status != 'pending'
    ORDER BY bet_at DESC LIMIT 10
  ) sub;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'config',       v_config,
    'balance',      COALESCE(v_balance, 0),
    'bets_today',   v_bets_today,
    'active_bet',   v_active,
    'stats',        COALESCE(v_stats, '{}'::jsonb),
    'history',      COALESCE(v_history, '[]'::jsonb)
  );

EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', SQLERRM);
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_admin_dashboard()
 RETURNS TABLE(total_users bigint, new_users_24h bigint, new_users_7d bigint, verified_users bigint, total_active_stakes bigint, total_staked_usd numeric, total_pending_rewards_usd numeric, active_pools_count bigint, fees_24h_usd numeric, fees_7d_usd numeric, fees_30d_usd numeric, swap_volume_24h_usd numeric, p2p_volume_24h_usd numeric, transactions_24h bigint, pending_withdrawals bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        -- Utilisateurs
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.users)::bigint,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.users WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours')::bigint,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.users WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days')::bigint,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.users WHERE is_verified = true)::bigint,

        -- Staking
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.user_stakes WHERE status = 'active')::bigint,
        (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(us.amount * COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0)), 2), 0)
         FROM public.user_stakes us
         JOIN public.staking_pools sp ON sp.id = us.pool_id
         LEFT JOIN public.asset_prices ap ON ap.asset_symbol = sp.asset_symbol
         WHERE us.status = 'active'),
        (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(us.pending_rewards * COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0)), 2), 0)
         FROM public.user_stakes us
         JOIN public.staking_pools sp ON sp.id = us.pool_id
         LEFT JOIN public.asset_prices ap
                ON ap.asset_symbol = COALESCE(sp.reward_asset_symbol, sp.asset_symbol)
         WHERE us.status = 'active'),
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.staking_pools WHERE is_active = true)::bigint,

        -- Frais
        (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(pf.amount * COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0)), 2), 0)
         FROM public.platform_fees pf
         LEFT JOIN public.asset_prices ap ON ap.asset_symbol = pf.asset_symbol
         WHERE pf.collected_at > now() - interval '24 hours'),
        (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(pf.amount * COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0)), 2), 0)
         FROM public.platform_fees pf
         LEFT JOIN public.asset_prices ap ON ap.asset_symbol = pf.asset_symbol
         WHERE pf.collected_at > now() - interval '7 days'),
        (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(pf.amount * COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0)), 2), 0)
         FROM public.platform_fees pf
         LEFT JOIN public.asset_prices ap ON ap.asset_symbol = pf.asset_symbol
         WHERE pf.collected_at > now() - interval '30 days'),

        -- Volumes 24h
        (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(t.amount * COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0)), 2), 0)
         FROM public.transactions t
         LEFT JOIN public.asset_prices ap ON ap.asset_symbol = t.asset_symbol
         WHERE t.type = 'swap_debit'
           AND t.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'),
        (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(t.amount * COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0)), 2), 0)
         FROM public.transactions t
         LEFT JOIN public.asset_prices ap ON ap.asset_symbol = t.asset_symbol
         WHERE t.type = 'p2p_transfer'
           AND t.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'),

        -- Transactions 24h
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.transactions
         WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours')::bigint,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.transactions
         WHERE type = 'withdrawal' AND status = 'pending')::bigint;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_admin_reconciliation()
 RETURNS TABLE(asset_symbol text, available_total numeric, staking_balance_total numeric, pending_total numeric, liability_fn numeric, liability_diff numeric, active_stakes_total numeric, staking_orphan numeric, negative_rows bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with bal as (
    select ub.asset_symbol,
           sum(ub.available_balance) as available,
           sum(coalesce(ub.staking_balance, 0)) as staking,
           sum(coalesce(ub.pending_balance, 0)) as pending,
           count(*) filter (where ub.available_balance < 0 or coalesce(ub.staking_balance,0) < 0 or coalesce(ub.pending_balance,0) < 0) as neg
    from user_balances ub group by 1
  ), stk as (
    select p.asset_symbol, sum(s.amount) as staked
    from user_stakes s join staking_pools p on p.id = s.pool_id
    where s.status = 'active' group by 1
  ), fn as (select l.asset_symbol, l.total_liability from get_asset_liabilities() l)
  select b.asset_symbol,
         round(b.available, 8), round(b.staking, 8), round(b.pending, 8),
         round(coalesce(fn.total_liability, 0), 8),
         round(b.available + b.staking + b.pending - coalesce(fn.total_liability, 0), 8),
         round(coalesce(stk.staked, 0), 8),
         round(b.staking - coalesce(stk.staked, 0), 8),
         b.neg
  from bal b
  left join fn on fn.asset_symbol = b.asset_symbol
  left join stk on stk.asset_symbol = b.asset_symbol
  order by b.asset_symbol
$function$

AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        sa.symbol,
        sa.name,
        sa.network,
        COALESCE(ub.available_balance, 0) AS available_balance,
        COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0) AS current_price_usd,
        COALESCE(ap.change_24h, 0) AS change_24h,  -- ✅ Utilise le nom exact de la colonne
        sa.can_be_swapped
    FROM public.supported_assets sa
    LEFT JOIN public.user_balances ub
        ON ub.asset_symbol = sa.symbol AND ub.user_id = p_user_id
    LEFT JOIN public.asset_prices ap
        ON ap.asset_symbol = sa.symbol
    WHERE sa.is_active = true
      AND sa.can_be_swapped = true
    ORDER BY COALESCE(ub.available_balance, 0) * COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0) DESC;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_stakes()

DECLARE
  v_user_id uuid := auth.uid();

BEGIN
  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN '[]'::jsonb;
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_result
  FROM (
    SELECT
      us.id               AS stake_id,
      us.pool_id,
      sp.name             AS pool_name,
      sp.asset_symbol,
      us.amount           AS staked,
      us.pending_rewards,
      us.rewards_earned,
      us.initial_apy       AS apr,
      us.staked_at,
      us.unlock_at,
      sp.lock_period_days,
      sp.instant_unstake_enabled,
      sp.instant_unstake_fee_percent,
      (us.unlock_at IS NOT NULL AND now() < us.unlock_at) AS is_locked
    FROM user_stakes us
    JOIN staking_pools sp ON sp.id = us.pool_id
    WHERE us.user_id = v_user_id AND us.status = 'active'
    ORDER BY us.staked_at DESC
  ) t;

  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_platform_revenue_report(p_from timestamp with time zone DEFAULT (now() - '30 days'::interval), p_to timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())
 RETURNS TABLE(fee_type text, asset_symbol text, total_collected numeric, total_collected_usd numeric, transaction_count bigint, avg_fee numeric, first_collected_at timestamp with time zone, last_collected_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        pf.fee_type,
        pf.asset_symbol,
        ROUND(SUM(pf.amount), 8)                                  AS total_collected,
        ROUND(SUM(pf.amount * COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0)), 2)      AS total_collected_usd,
        COUNT(*)::bigint                                           AS transaction_count,
        ROUND(AVG(pf.amount), 8)                                   AS avg_fee,
        MIN(pf.collected_at)                                       AS first_collected_at,
        MAX(pf.collected_at)                                       AS last_collected_at
    FROM public.platform_fees pf
    LEFT JOIN public.asset_prices ap ON ap.asset_symbol = pf.asset_symbol
    WHERE pf.collected_at BETWEEN p_from AND p_to
    GROUP BY pf.fee_type, pf.asset_symbol
    ORDER BY total_collected_usd DESC;
END;
$function$

Rapport des revenus de la plateforme sur une période. Défaut : 30 derniers jours.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_realtime_prices(p_symbols text[])
 RETURNS TABLE(symbol text, current_price_usd numeric, price_change_24h numeric, last_update timestamp with time zone, is_success boolean, error_message text, source text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_edge_function_url text := 'https://jbzbwyuawejdhhutkmkk.supabase.co/functions/v1';
    v_response json;
BEGIN
    BEGIN
        SELECT content::json INTO v_response
        FROM http((
            'GET',
            v_edge_function_url || '/get-prices?symbols=' || array_to_string(p_symbols, ','),
            ARRAY[http_header('Accept', 'application/json')],
            '',
            ''
        )::http_request);

        IF v_response->>'success' = 'true' THEN
            FOR symbol IN SELECT unnest(p_symbols)
            LOOP
                RETURN QUERY SELECT
                    symbol,
                    COALESCE((v_response->'prices'->symbol->>'current_price_usd')::numeric, 0),
                    COALESCE((v_response->'prices'->symbol->>'price_change_24h')::numeric, 0),
                    COALESCE((v_response->'prices'->symbol->>'last_update')::timestamptz, NOW()),
                    (v_response->'prices'->symbol->>'current_price_usd') IS NOT NULL,
                    CASE WHEN (v_response->'prices'->symbol->>'current_price_usd') IS NULL
                         THEN 'Prix non disponible' ELSE NULL END,
                    COALESCE(v_response->>'source', 'unknown');
            END LOOP;
            RETURN;
        END IF;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
        RAISE NOTICE 'Erreur appel Edge Function: %, utilisation cache', SQLERRM;
    END;

    -- FALLBACK : lire depuis asset_prices (nouvelle table dédiée aux prix)
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        sa.symbol,
        COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0),
        COALESCE(ap.change_24h, 0),
        ap.updated_at,
        (ap.price_usd > 0 AND ap.updated_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'),
        CASE
            WHEN ap.price_usd IS NULL OR ap.price_usd <= 0 THEN 'Prix nul en cache'
            WHEN ap.updated_at <= NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes' THEN 'Prix en cache obsolètes'
            ELSE NULL
        END,
        'cache'
    FROM supported_assets sa
    LEFT JOIN asset_prices ap ON ap.asset_symbol = sa.symbol
    WHERE sa.symbol = ANY(p_symbols)
    AND sa.is_active = true;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_strategy_convergence(p_symbol text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_total       integer := 0;
  v_bullish     integer := 0;
  v_bearish     integer := 0;
  v_neutral     integer := 0;
  v_trend       text    := 'neutral';
  v_total_strats integer := 0;
BEGIN
  -- Nombre total de stratégies actives (dynamique)
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_total_strats
  FROM trading_strategy_config
  WHERE is_active = true;

  SELECT
    COUNT(*)                                                                      AS total,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE signal IN ('STRONG_BUY','BUY','LONG_STRONG','LONG'))  AS bullish,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE signal IN ('STRONG_SELL','SELL','SHORT_STRONG','SHORT')) AS bearish,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE signal = 'WAIT')                                       AS neutral
  INTO v_total, v_bullish, v_bearish, v_neutral
  FROM (
    -- La plus récente analyse par stratégie sur ce symbole (dernières 24h)
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (strategy_key) signal
    FROM public.trading_analyses
    WHERE symbol     = p_symbol
      AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    ORDER BY strategy_key, created_at DESC
  ) sub;

  IF v_bullish > v_bearish THEN
    v_trend := 'bullish';
  ELSIF v_bearish > v_bullish THEN
    v_trend := 'bearish';
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'symbol',                   p_symbol,
    'total',                    v_total,
    'total_strategies_available', v_total_strats,
    'coverage_pct',             CASE WHEN v_total_strats > 0
                                     THEN ROUND((v_total::numeric / v_total_strats) * 100)
                                     ELSE 0 END,
    'bullish',                  v_bullish,
    'bearish',                  v_bearish,
    'neutral',                  v_neutral,
    'trend',                    v_trend,
    'label',                    format('%s/%s stratégies haussières', v_bullish, v_total_strats)
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_strategy_performance()
 RETURNS TABLE(strategy_key text, wins bigint, losses bigint, total bigint, win_rate numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT
    strategy_key,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE actual_outcome = 'win')  AS wins,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE actual_outcome = 'loss') AS losses,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE actual_outcome IN ('win','loss')) AS total,
    ROUND(
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE actual_outcome = 'win')::numeric /
      NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE actual_outcome IN ('win','loss')), 0) * 100,
      2
    ) AS win_rate
  FROM public.trading_prediction_history
  WHERE strategy_key IS NOT NULL
    AND actual_outcome IN ('win', 'loss')
  GROUP BY strategy_key
  ORDER BY win_rate DESC NULLS LAST;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_swap_rates(p_from_asset text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_to_asset text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(from_asset text, to_asset text, exchange_rate numeric, inverse_rate numeric, from_asset_price_usd numeric, to_asset_price_usd numeric, fee_percentage numeric, is_available boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH asset_pairs AS (
        SELECT
            sa1.symbol           AS from_symbol,
            sa2.symbol           AS to_symbol,
            COALESCE(ap1.price_usd, 0) AS from_price,
            COALESCE(ap2.price_usd, 0) AS to_price,
            COALESCE(sa2.transfer_fee_percentage, 0.5) AS fee_pct,
            (sa1.is_active AND sa2.is_active AND sa1.can_be_swapped AND sa2.can_be_swapped) AS available
        FROM supported_assets sa1
        CROSS JOIN supported_assets sa2
        LEFT JOIN asset_prices ap1 ON ap1.asset_symbol = sa1.symbol
        LEFT JOIN asset_prices ap2 ON ap2.asset_symbol = sa2.symbol
        WHERE sa1.symbol != sa2.symbol
        AND sa1.is_active = true
        AND sa2.is_active = true
        AND (p_from_asset IS NULL OR sa1.symbol = p_from_asset)
        AND (p_to_asset   IS NULL OR sa2.symbol = p_to_asset)
    )
    SELECT
        ap.from_symbol,
        ap.to_symbol,
        CASE WHEN ap.to_price > 0 THEN ap.from_price / ap.to_price ELSE 0 END,
        CASE WHEN ap.from_price > 0 THEN ap.to_price / ap.from_price ELSE 0 END,
        ap.from_price,
        ap.to_price,
        ap.fee_pct,
        ap.available AND (ap.from_price > 0) AND (ap.to_price > 0)
    FROM asset_pairs ap
    ORDER BY ap.from_symbol, ap.to_symbol;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_transaction_impact(p_type text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
    SELECT CASE p_type
        -- CRÉDITS (argent reçu)
        WHEN 'deposit'            THEN 'credit'
        WHEN 'staking_reward'     THEN 'credit'
        WHEN 'unstake_completed'  THEN 'credit'  -- ← corrigé : l'user reçoit ses tokens
        WHEN 'game_win'           THEN 'credit'
        WHEN 'referral_bonus'     THEN 'credit'
        WHEN 'cashback'           THEN 'credit'
        WHEN 'refund'             THEN 'credit'
        WHEN 'commission'         THEN 'credit'
        WHEN 'dividend_payment'   THEN 'credit'
        WHEN 'lending_reward'     THEN 'credit'
        WHEN 'swap_credit'        THEN 'credit'
        WHEN 'asset_conversion'   THEN 'credit'

        -- DÉBITS (argent envoyé)
        WHEN 'withdrawal'         THEN 'debit'
        WHEN 'staking'            THEN 'debit'
        WHEN 'staking_lock'       THEN 'debit'
        WHEN 'unstaking'          THEN 'debit'
        WHEN 'game_bet'           THEN 'debit'
        WHEN 'wakati_purchase'    THEN 'debit'
        WHEN 'fee'                THEN 'debit'
        WHEN 'platform_fee'       THEN 'debit'
        WHEN 'swap_debit'         THEN 'debit'

        -- NEUTRES (transferts — montant net = 0 pour la plateforme)
        WHEN 'transfer'           THEN 'neutral'
        WHEN 'p2p_transfer'       THEN 'neutral'
        WHEN 'internal_transfer'  THEN 'neutral'
        WHEN 'balance_adjustment' THEN 'neutral'

        ELSE 'neutral'
    END;
$function$
description:
Retourne credit/debit/neutral selon le type de transaction.
Note : unstake_completed est un CRÉDIT (l'utilisateur reçoit ses tokens).
Utilisé côté frontend pour afficher le signe +/- dans l'historique.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_assets_for_purchase(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(asset_symbol text, asset_name text, available_balance numeric, current_price_usd numeric, wakati_exchange_rate numeric, max_wakati_purchasable numeric, is_eligible boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_wakati_price numeric;
  v_fee_pct      numeric := 0.5;  -- frais par défaut 0.5%
BEGIN
  -- Prix WAKATI actuel
  SELECT ap_w.price_usd INTO v_wakati_price
  FROM public.asset_prices ap_w
  WHERE ap_w.asset_symbol = 'WAKATI'
  LIMIT 1;

  -- Si WAKATI n'a pas de prix, impossible de calculer
  IF v_wakati_price IS NULL OR v_wakati_price = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Prix WAKATI introuvable ou nul dans asset_prices';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    ub.asset_symbol,
    sa.name                                           AS asset_name,
    ub.available_balance,
    COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0)                        AS current_price_usd,

    -- Taux : combien de WAKATI pour 1 unité de l'asset
    -- Ex: BNB = $300, WAKATI = $0.0018 → 300 / 0.0018 = 166 666 WAKATI/BNB
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0) > 0
      THEN ROUND(ap.price_usd / v_wakati_price, 2)
      ELSE 0
    END                                               AS wakati_exchange_rate,

    -- Max WAKATI achetable avec le solde disponible, frais déduits
    -- total_debit = from_amount * (1 + fee%) → from_amount = balance / (1 + fee%)
    -- wakati_max = from_amount * exchange_rate
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0) > 0
      THEN ROUND(
        (ub.available_balance / (1 + v_fee_pct / 100))
        * (ap.price_usd / v_wakati_price),
        2
      )
      ELSE 0
    END                                               AS max_wakati_purchasable,

    (ub.available_balance > 0 AND sa.is_active = true) AS is_eligible

  FROM public.user_balances ub
  JOIN public.supported_assets sa
    ON ub.asset_symbol = sa.symbol
  LEFT JOIN public.asset_prices ap
    ON ap.asset_symbol = ub.asset_symbol
  WHERE ub.user_id          = p_user_id
    AND ub.available_balance > 0
    AND ub.asset_symbol     != 'WAKATI'
    AND sa.is_active         = true
  ORDER BY (ub.available_balance * COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0)) DESC;  -- tri par valeur USD décroissante
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_portfolio(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(asset_symbol text, asset_name text, available_balance numeric, staking_balance numeric, total_balance numeric, price_usd numeric, value_usd numeric, staking_value_usd numeric, total_value_usd numeric, pct_of_portfolio numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_total_usd numeric;
BEGIN
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
        (COALESCE(ub.available_balance, 0) + COALESCE(ub.staking_balance, 0))
        * COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0)
    ), 0)
    INTO v_total_usd
    FROM (
        -- Prefere le nom d'un reseau "officiel" (non-BSC/Binance-Peg) pour
        -- l'affichage unifie, purement cosmetique.
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (sa.ledger_symbol) sa.ledger_symbol, sa.name
        FROM public.supported_assets sa
        WHERE sa.is_active = true
        ORDER BY sa.ledger_symbol, sa.is_native DESC, (sa.network = 'BSC') ASC, sa.symbol
    ) ua
    LEFT JOIN public.user_balances ub ON ub.asset_symbol = ua.ledger_symbol
                                     AND ub.user_id = p_user_id
    LEFT JOIN public.asset_prices ap  ON ap.asset_symbol = ua.ledger_symbol;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        ua.ledger_symbol,
        ua.name,
        ROUND(COALESCE(ub.available_balance, 0), 8)                          AS available_balance,
        ROUND(COALESCE(ub.staking_balance, 0), 8)                            AS staking_balance,
        ROUND(COALESCE(ub.available_balance, 0)
            + COALESCE(ub.staking_balance, 0), 8)                            AS total_balance,
        COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0)                                            AS price_usd,
        ROUND(COALESCE(ub.available_balance, 0)
            * COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0), 2)                                  AS value_usd,
        ROUND(COALESCE(ub.staking_balance, 0)
            * COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0), 2)                                  AS staking_value_usd,
        ROUND((COALESCE(ub.available_balance, 0)
            + COALESCE(ub.staking_balance, 0))
            * COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0), 2)                                  AS total_value_usd,
        CASE
            WHEN v_total_usd = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE ROUND(
                (COALESCE(ub.available_balance, 0) + COALESCE(ub.staking_balance, 0))
                * COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0) / v_total_usd * 100, 2
            )
        END                                                                   AS pct_of_portfolio
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (sa.ledger_symbol) sa.ledger_symbol, sa.name
        FROM public.supported_assets sa
        WHERE sa.is_active = true
        ORDER BY sa.ledger_symbol, sa.is_native DESC, (sa.network = 'BSC') ASC, sa.symbol
    ) ua
    LEFT JOIN public.user_balances ub ON ub.asset_symbol = ua.ledger_symbol
                                     AND ub.user_id = p_user_id
    LEFT JOIN public.asset_prices ap  ON ap.asset_symbol = ua.ledger_symbol
    ORDER BY total_value_usd DESC, ua.ledger_symbol ASC;
END;
$function$
description:
Retourne le portefeuille complet d'un utilisateur avec valorisation USD et répartition.
Inclut les balances disponibles et en staking.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_portfolio_stats(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(total_portfolio_value_usd numeric, total_onchain_deposited_usd numeric, total_earned_usd numeric, daily_change_usd numeric, daily_change_percent numeric, weekly_change_usd numeric, total_staking_value_usd numeric, asset_count integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH
    deposits AS (
        SELECT asset_symbol, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total
        FROM transactions
        WHERE user_id = p_user_id AND type = 'deposit' AND status = 'completed'
        GROUP BY asset_symbol
    ),
    withdrawals AS (
        SELECT asset_symbol, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total
        FROM transactions
        WHERE user_id = p_user_id AND type IN ('withdraw', 'withdrawal') AND status = 'completed'
        GROUP BY asset_symbol
    ),
    portfolio_data AS (
        SELECT
            ub.asset_symbol,
            ub.available_balance,
            ub.staking_balance,
            COALESCE(d.total, 0)                         AS onchain_deposited,
            COALESCE(w.total, 0)                         AS admin_withdrawn,
            COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0)                    AS current_price_usd,
            COALESCE(ap.change_24h, 0)                   AS price_change_24h
        FROM user_balances ub
        JOIN supported_assets sa ON ub.asset_symbol = sa.symbol
        LEFT JOIN asset_prices ap ON ap.asset_symbol = ub.asset_symbol
        LEFT JOIN deposits      d  ON d.asset_symbol = ub.asset_symbol
        LEFT JOIN withdrawals   w  ON w.asset_symbol = ub.asset_symbol
        WHERE ub.user_id = p_user_id
        AND ub.available_balance > 0
    )
    SELECT
        SUM(pd.available_balance * pd.current_price_usd),
        SUM(pd.onchain_deposited * pd.current_price_usd),
        SUM((pd.available_balance
             - (pd.onchain_deposited - pd.admin_withdrawn))
             * pd.current_price_usd),
        SUM(pd.available_balance * pd.current_price_usd * (pd.price_change_24h / 100)),
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(pd.available_balance * pd.current_price_usd) > 0
            THEN (SUM(pd.available_balance * pd.current_price_usd * (pd.price_change_24h / 100))
                  / SUM(pd.available_balance * pd.current_price_usd)) * 100
            ELSE 0
        END,
        0::numeric,
        SUM(pd.staking_balance * pd.current_price_usd),
        COUNT(*)::integer
    FROM portfolio_data pd;
END;
$function$

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        t_credit.id as transaction_id,
        t_debit.metadata->>'from_asset' as from_asset,
        t_credit.asset_symbol as to_asset,
        (t_debit.amount)::numeric as from_amount,
        t_credit.amount as to_amount,
        (t_credit.metadata->>'exchange_rate')::numeric as exchange_rate,
        COALESCE((t_fee.amount)::numeric, 0) as fee_amount,
        t_credit.created_at
    FROM transactions t_credit
    JOIN transactions t_debit ON t_credit.reference_id = t_debit.id
    LEFT JOIN transactions t_fee ON t_fee.reference_id = t_debit.id AND t_fee.type = 'swap_fee'
    WHERE t_credit.user_id = p_user_id
    AND t_credit.type = 'swap_credit'
    ORDER BY t_credit.created_at DESC
    LIMIT p_limit
    OFFSET p_offset;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.increment_balance(p_user_id uuid, p_asset_symbol text, p_amount numeric)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  new_balance numeric;
BEGIN
  -- Réservé aux rôles internes uniquement
  IF current_role NOT IN ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'increment_balance: accès non autorisé (rôle: %)', current_role
    USING ERRCODE = 'insufficient_privilege';
  END IF;

  -- Validation du montant
  IF p_amount <= 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'increment_balance: le montant doit être positif (reçu: %)', p_amount
    USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
  END IF;

  -- ✅ CORRECTION : UPSERT au lieu de simple UPDATE
  -- Si la ligne n'existe pas, on la crée avec un solde initial = p_amount
  -- Si elle existe, on incrémente simplement
  INSERT INTO user_balances (user_id, asset_symbol, available_balance, staking_balance, updated_at)
  VALUES (p_user_id, p_asset_symbol, p_amount, 0, now())
  ON CONFLICT (user_id, asset_symbol) 
  DO UPDATE SET 
    available_balance = user_balances.available_balance + p_amount,
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING available_balance INTO new_balance;

  RETURN new_balance;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.initialize_user_data(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- 1. Initialiser les balances pour les assets actifs
  INSERT INTO user_balances (user_id, asset_symbol, available_balance)
  SELECT 
    p_user_id,
    sa.symbol,
    0
  FROM supported_assets sa
  WHERE sa.is_active = true
  ON CONFLICT (user_id, asset_symbol) 
  DO UPDATE SET updated_at = NOW(); -- Juste mettre à jour le timestamp
  
  -- 2. Initialiser les multiplicateurs
  INSERT INTO user_active_multipliers (user_id, multiplier_value, spins_remaining)
  VALUES (p_user_id, 1, 0)
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) 
  DO UPDATE SET updated_at = NOW();
  
  -- 3. Initialiser les limites de transaction
  INSERT INTO user_transaction_limits (user_id)
  VALUES (p_user_id)
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) 
  DO NOTHING;
  
  -- 4. Journaliser
  INSERT INTO auth_logs (
    user_id,
    action,
    details,
    created_at
  ) VALUES (
    p_user_id,
    'data_initialized',
    jsonb_build_object('assets_initialized', (
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM supported_assets WHERE is_active = true
    )),
    NOW()
  );
  
EXCEPTION
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    -- Journaliser l'erreur mais ne pas bloquer
    INSERT INTO auth_logs (
      user_id,
      action,
      details,
      error_message,
      created_at
    ) VALUES (
      p_user_id,
      'data_initialization_error',
      '{}'::jsonb,
      SQLERRM,
      NOW()
    );
    
    RAISE NOTICE 'Erreur initialisation données pour user_id %: %', p_user_id, SQLERRM;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rollback_airtime_purchase(p_external_reference text, p_amount numeric, p_reason text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_tx_id uuid;
  v_user_id uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT id, user_id INTO v_tx_id, v_user_id
  FROM transactions
  WHERE metadata->>'external_reference' = p_external_reference
    AND type = 'airtime_purchase'
    AND status = 'pending'
  LIMIT 1;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Transaction non trouvée');
  END IF;

  -- Rembourser l'utilisateur
  PERFORM increment_balance(v_user_id, 'FCFA', p_amount);

  -- Restaurer les limites consommées à tort par la tentative échouée
  UPDATE user_transaction_limits
  SET daily_withdraw_used = GREATEST(0, daily_withdraw_used - p_amount),
      monthly_withdraw_used = GREATEST(0, monthly_withdraw_used - p_amount),
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE user_id = v_user_id;

  -- Marquer comme échoué
  UPDATE transactions 
  SET status = 'failed',
      metadata = metadata || jsonb_build_object('failure_reason', p_reason, 'rolled_back_at', now()),
      completed_at = now()
  WHERE id = v_tx_id;

  -- Notification
  INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, title, message, data)
  VALUES (
    v_user_id, 'airtime_failed', 'Achat de crédit annulé ❌', 
    format('Votre achat de crédit a échoué. %s FCFA ont été remboursés.', p_amount),
    jsonb_build_object('amount', p_amount, 'reason', p_reason)
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'transaction_id', v_tx_id);
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', SQLERRM);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rollback_campay_withdrawal(p_external_reference text, p_amount numeric, p_reason text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_tx_id uuid;
  v_user_id uuid;
BEGIN
  -- FOR UPDATE : sans ce verrou, deux callbacks FAILED simultanes peuvent tous
  -- deux lire 'pending' et rembourser l'utilisateur DEUX FOIS.
  SELECT id, user_id INTO v_tx_id, v_user_id
  FROM transactions
  WHERE metadata->>'external_reference' = p_external_reference
    AND type = 'withdrawal'
    AND status = 'pending'
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Transaction de retrait non trouvée');
  END IF;

  -- Marquer comme echoue AVANT de rembourser : un appel concurrent en attente
  -- sur le verrou relira 'failed' et sortira proprement en NOT FOUND.
  UPDATE transactions
  SET status = 'failed',
      metadata = metadata || jsonb_build_object('failure_reason', p_reason, 'rolled_back_at', now()),
      completed_at = now()
  WHERE id = v_tx_id;

  -- Rembourser l'utilisateur
  PERFORM increment_balance(v_user_id, 'FCFA', p_amount);

  -- Notification
  INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, title, message, data)
  VALUES (
    v_user_id, 'withdrawal_failed', 'Retrait annulé ❌',
    format('Votre retrait a échoué. %s FCFA ont été remboursés sur votre compte.', p_amount),
    jsonb_build_object('amount', p_amount, 'reason', p_reason)
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'transaction_id', v_tx_id);
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', SQLERRM);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_user_for_p2p(p_query text, p_self_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, username text, display_name text, is_verified boolean, match_type text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_clean_query text;
BEGIN
    -- Nettoyer la requête
    v_clean_query := trim(p_query);

    -- 1. Recherche par username (exact ou LIKE)
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        u.id,
        u.username,
        COALESCE(u.username, split_part(u.email, '@', 1)) as display_name,
        u.is_verified,
        CASE 
            WHEN lower(u.username) = lower(v_clean_query) THEN 'username_exact'
            ELSE 'username_partial'
        END as match_type
    FROM public.users u
    WHERE (lower(u.username) = lower(v_clean_query) 
           OR lower(u.username) LIKE '%' || lower(v_clean_query) || '%')
      AND (p_self_id IS NULL OR u.id != p_self_id)
    ORDER BY 
        CASE 
            WHEN lower(u.username) = lower(v_clean_query) THEN 1
            ELSE 2
        END,
        u.username
    LIMIT 5;

    -- Si on a des résultats, on s'arrête
    IF FOUND THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    -- 2. Recherche par email (exact)
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        u.id,
        u.username,
        COALESCE(u.username, split_part(u.email, '@', 1)) as display_name,
        u.is_verified,
        'email_exact'::text as match_type
    FROM public.users u
    WHERE lower(u.email) = lower(v_clean_query)
      AND (p_self_id IS NULL OR u.id != p_self_id)
    LIMIT 1;

    IF FOUND THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    -- 3. Recherche par code de parrainage (exact)
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        u.id,
        u.username,
        COALESCE(u.username, split_part(u.email, '@', 1)) as display_name,
        u.is_verified,
        'referral_code'::text as match_type
    FROM public.users u
    WHERE upper(u.referral_code) = upper(v_clean_query)
      AND (p_self_id IS NULL OR u.id != p_self_id)
    LIMIT 1;

    IF FOUND THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    -- 4. Recherche par téléphone (exact)
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        u.id,
        u.username,
        COALESCE(u.username, split_part(u.email, '@', 1)) as display_name,
        u.is_verified,
        'phone'::text as match_type
    FROM public.users u
    WHERE u.phone = v_clean_query
      AND (p_self_id IS NULL OR u.id != p_self_id)
    LIMIT 1;

    -- 5. Si toujours rien, recherche partielle sur email
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RETURN QUERY
        SELECT 
            u.id,
            u.username,
            COALESCE(u.username, split_part(u.email, '@', 1)) as display_name,
            u.is_verified,
            'email_partial'::text as match_type
        FROM public.users u
        WHERE lower(u.email) LIKE '%' || lower(v_clean_query) || '%'
          AND (p_self_id IS NULL OR u.id != p_self_id)
        LIMIT 5;
    END IF;
END;
$function$
description:
Recherche un utilisateur par email, username, code referral ou téléphone.
Fallback progressif dans cet ordre. Retourne au plus 1 résultat.
Trigger générique : met à jour updated_at automatiquement sur chaque modification.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.take_admin_snapshot()
 RETURNS TABLE(success boolean, snapshot_date date, message text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_today             date := CURRENT_DATE;
    v_total_users       integer;
    v_new_users         integer;
    v_active_stakes     integer;
    v_total_staked_usd  numeric;
    v_total_rewards_usd numeric;
    v_total_fees_usd    numeric;
    v_fees_by_type      jsonb;
    v_fees_by_asset     jsonb;
    v_swap_volume_usd   numeric;
    v_p2p_volume_usd    numeric;
    v_deposits_usd      numeric;
    v_withdrawals_usd   numeric;
    v_active_pools      integer;
BEGIN
    -- Éviter les doublons
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.admin_dashboard_snapshots
        WHERE snapshot_date = v_today
    ) THEN
        RETURN QUERY SELECT false, v_today, 'Snapshot déjà effectué aujourd''hui';
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    -- ── Utilisateurs ─────────────────────────────────────────
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_total_users FROM public.users;

    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_new_users
    FROM public.users
    WHERE created_at::date = v_today;

    -- ── Staking ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_active_stakes
    FROM public.user_stakes WHERE status = 'active';

    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(us.amount * COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0)), 0)
    INTO v_total_staked_usd
    FROM public.user_stakes us
    JOIN public.staking_pools sp ON sp.id = us.pool_id
    LEFT JOIN public.asset_prices ap ON ap.asset_symbol = sp.asset_symbol
    WHERE us.status = 'active';

    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount * COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0)), 0)
    INTO v_total_rewards_usd
    FROM public.transactions t
    LEFT JOIN public.asset_prices ap ON ap.asset_symbol = t.asset_symbol
    WHERE t.type = 'staking_reward'
      AND t.created_at::date = v_today;

    -- ── Frais ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pf.amount * COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0)), 0)
    INTO v_total_fees_usd
    FROM public.platform_fees pf
    LEFT JOIN public.asset_prices ap ON ap.asset_symbol = pf.asset_symbol
    WHERE pf.collected_at::date = v_today;

    -- Frais par type (JSON)
    SELECT COALESCE(
        jsonb_object_agg(fee_type, total),
        '{}'::jsonb
    )
    INTO v_fees_by_type
    FROM (
        SELECT
            pf.fee_type,
            ROUND(SUM(pf.amount * COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0)), 2) AS total
        FROM public.platform_fees pf
        LEFT JOIN public.asset_prices ap ON ap.asset_symbol = pf.asset_symbol
        WHERE pf.collected_at::date = v_today
        GROUP BY pf.fee_type
    ) sub;

    -- Frais par asset (JSON)
    SELECT COALESCE(
        jsonb_object_agg(asset_symbol, total),
        '{}'::jsonb
    )
    INTO v_fees_by_asset
    FROM (
        SELECT
            pf.asset_symbol,
            ROUND(SUM(pf.amount), 8) AS total
        FROM public.platform_fees pf
        WHERE pf.collected_at::date = v_today
        GROUP BY pf.asset_symbol
    ) sub;

    -- ── Volumes ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    -- Volume swap (swap_debit = côté départ = montant exact)
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount * COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0)), 0)
    INTO v_swap_volume_usd
    FROM public.transactions t
    LEFT JOIN public.asset_prices ap ON ap.asset_symbol = t.asset_symbol
    WHERE t.type = 'swap_debit'
      AND t.created_at::date = v_today;

    -- Volume P2P
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount * COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0)), 0)
    INTO v_p2p_volume_usd
    FROM public.transactions t
    LEFT JOIN public.asset_prices ap ON ap.asset_symbol = t.asset_symbol
    WHERE t.type = 'p2p_transfer'
      AND t.created_at::date = v_today;

    -- Dépôts
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount * COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0)), 0)
    INTO v_deposits_usd
    FROM public.transactions t
    LEFT JOIN public.asset_prices ap ON ap.asset_symbol = t.asset_symbol
    WHERE t.type = 'deposit'
      AND t.created_at::date = v_today;

    -- Retraits
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount * COALESCE(ap.price_usd, 0)), 0)
    INTO v_withdrawals_usd
    FROM public.transactions t
    LEFT JOIN public.asset_prices ap ON ap.asset_symbol = t.asset_symbol
    WHERE t.type = 'withdrawal'
      AND t.created_at::date = v_today;

    -- Pools actifs
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_active_pools
    FROM public.staking_pools WHERE is_active = true;

    -- ── Insérer le snapshot ───────────────────────────────────
    INSERT INTO public.admin_dashboard_snapshots (
        snapshot_date,
        total_users,
        new_users_today,
        total_active_stakes,
        total_staked_usd,
        total_rewards_distributed_usd,
        total_fees_collected_usd,
        fees_by_type,
        fees_by_asset,
        total_swap_volume_usd,
        total_p2p_volume_usd,
        total_deposits_usd,
        total_withdrawals_usd,
        active_pools
    ) VALUES (
        v_today,
        v_total_users,
        v_new_users,
        v_active_stakes,
        ROUND(v_total_staked_usd, 2),
        ROUND(v_total_rewards_usd, 2),
        ROUND(v_total_fees_usd, 2),
        v_fees_by_type,
        v_fees_by_asset,
        ROUND(v_swap_volume_usd, 2),
        ROUND(v_p2p_volume_usd, 2),
        ROUND(v_deposits_usd, 2),
        ROUND(v_withdrawals_usd, 2),
        v_active_pools
    );

    RETURN QUERY SELECT true, v_today,
        format('Snapshot créé : %s users | %s stakes | $%s staked | $%s fees',
               v_total_users, v_active_stakes,
               ROUND(v_total_staked_usd, 0),
               ROUND(v_total_fees_usd, 2));

EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    RETURN QUERY SELECT false, v_today, 'Erreur : ' || SQLERRM;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trading_consume_access(p_user_id uuid, p_service_key text, p_symbol text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_grant_id uuid;
BEGIN
  -- Trouver et verrouiller le grant (FOR UPDATE évite les race conditions)
  SELECT id INTO v_grant_id
  FROM public.trading_access_grants
  WHERE user_id     = p_user_id
    AND service_key = p_service_key
    AND status      = 'active'
    AND uses_remaining > 0
    AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW())
    AND (p_symbol IS NULL OR target_symbol IS NULL OR target_symbol = p_symbol)
  ORDER BY granted_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  -- Décrémenter et marquer exhausted si plus d'utilisations
  UPDATE public.trading_access_grants
  SET uses_remaining = uses_remaining - 1,
      last_used_at   = NOW(),
      status = CASE
        WHEN uses_remaining - 1 <= 0 THEN 'exhausted'
        ELSE 'active'
      END
  WHERE id = v_grant_id;

  RETURN true;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_round_platform_fees()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  new.amount := case when round(new.amount, 18) > 0 then round(new.amount, 18) else new.amount end;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_sync_pool_total()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_pool_id uuid := COALESCE(NEW.pool_id, OLD.pool_id);
BEGIN
    UPDATE staking_pools
    SET
        total_staked = (
            SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0)
            FROM user_stakes
            WHERE pool_id = v_pool_id AND status = 'active'
        ),
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = v_pool_id;

    RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_asset_metrics_on_transaction()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- Ignorer les transactions non complétées
    IF NEW.status != 'completed' THEN
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;

    -- Mise à jour des métriques existantes
    UPDATE public.supported_assets_metrics
    SET
        total_swap_volume = COALESCE(total_swap_volume, 0) + CASE
            WHEN NEW.type IN ('swap_debit', 'swap_credit') THEN NEW.amount ELSE 0 END,

        -- ✅ CORRECTION: Les frais sont uniquement sur swap_credit
        total_swap_fees_collected = COALESCE(total_swap_fees_collected, 0) + CASE
            WHEN NEW.type = 'swap_credit' AND NEW.fee > 0 THEN NEW.fee ELSE 0 END,

        total_p2p_volume = COALESCE(total_p2p_volume, 0) + CASE
            WHEN NEW.type = 'p2p_transfer' THEN NEW.amount ELSE 0 END,

        total_p2p_fees_collected = COALESCE(total_p2p_fees_collected, 0) + CASE
            WHEN NEW.type = 'p2p_transfer' AND NEW.fee > 0 THEN NEW.fee ELSE 0 END,

        total_withdraw_fees_collected = COALESCE(total_withdraw_fees_collected, 0) + CASE
            WHEN NEW.type = 'withdrawal' AND NEW.fee > 0 THEN NEW.fee ELSE 0 END,

        -- ✅ CORRECTION: total_fees_collected aussi uniquement sur swap_credit
        total_fees_collected = COALESCE(total_fees_collected, 0) + CASE
            WHEN NEW.type = 'swap_credit' AND NEW.fee > 0 THEN NEW.fee
            WHEN NEW.type = 'p2p_transfer' AND NEW.fee > 0 THEN NEW.fee
            WHEN NEW.type = 'withdrawal' AND NEW.fee > 0 THEN NEW.fee
            ELSE 0 END,

        last_updated = now()
    WHERE asset_symbol = NEW.asset_symbol;

    -- Insertion pour les nouveaux assets
    INSERT INTO public.supported_assets_metrics (
        asset_symbol,
        total_swap_volume,
        total_swap_fees_collected,
        total_p2p_volume,
        total_p2p_fees_collected,
        total_withdraw_fees_collected,
        total_fees_collected,
        total_deposited,
        total_withdrawn,
        total_staked,
        total_user_balance,
        net_position,
        should_be_in_custody,
        last_updated
    )
    SELECT 
        NEW.asset_symbol,
        CASE WHEN NEW.type IN ('swap_debit', 'swap_credit') THEN NEW.amount ELSE 0 END,
        -- ✅ CORRECTION: Ici aussi, frais uniquement sur swap_credit
        CASE WHEN NEW.type = 'swap_credit' AND NEW.fee > 0 THEN NEW.fee ELSE 0 END,
        CASE WHEN NEW.type = 'p2p_transfer' THEN NEW.amount ELSE 0 END,
        CASE WHEN NEW.type = 'p2p_transfer' AND NEW.fee > 0 THEN NEW.fee ELSE 0 END,
        CASE WHEN NEW.type = 'withdrawal' AND NEW.fee > 0 THEN NEW.fee ELSE 0 END,
        CASE 
            WHEN NEW.type = 'swap_credit' AND NEW.fee > 0 THEN NEW.fee
            WHEN NEW.type = 'p2p_transfer' AND NEW.fee > 0 THEN NEW.fee
            WHEN NEW.type = 'withdrawal' AND NEW.fee > 0 THEN NEW.fee
            ELSE 0 END,
        0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0,
        NOW()
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.supported_assets_metrics 
        WHERE asset_symbol = NEW.asset_symbol
    );

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
description: Trigger : met à jour les métriques de l'asset après chaque transaction complétée.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_fee_metrics(p_asset_symbol text, p_fee_amount numeric, p_fee_type text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF p_fee_amount <= 0 THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;
    
    UPDATE public.supported_assets_metrics
    SET 
        total_fees_collected = COALESCE(total_fees_collected, 0) + p_fee_amount,
        fees_breakdown = jsonb_set(
            COALESCE(fees_breakdown, '{"swap":0,"p2p":0,"withdraw":0,"unstake":0,"other":0}'::jsonb),
            ARRAY[p_fee_type],
            to_jsonb(
                COALESCE((fees_breakdown->>p_fee_type)::numeric, 0) + p_fee_amount
            )
        ),
        last_fee_collection_date = NOW(),
        last_updated = NOW()
    WHERE asset_symbol = p_asset_symbol;
    
    RAISE NOTICE 'Fees updated: % % (type: %)', p_fee_amount, p_asset_symbol, p_fee_type;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_swap_metrics(p_from_asset text, p_to_asset text, p_from_amount numeric, p_to_amount numeric, p_fee_amount numeric)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- Mettre à jour pour l'asset source
    IF p_from_asset != 'WAKATI' THEN
        UPDATE supported_assets_metrics
        SET 
            total_swap_volume = total_swap_volume + p_from_amount,
            last_updated = NOW()
        WHERE asset_symbol = p_from_asset;
    END IF;
    
    -- Mettre à jour pour l'asset destination
    IF p_to_asset != 'WAKATI' THEN
        UPDATE supported_assets_metrics
        SET 
            total_swap_volume = total_swap_volume + p_to_amount,
            total_swap_fees_collected = total_swap_fees_collected + p_fee_amount,
            last_updated = NOW()
        WHERE asset_symbol = p_to_asset;
        
        -- ✅ Mettre à jour aussi total_fees_collected
        UPDATE supported_assets_metrics
        SET 
            total_fees_collected = COALESCE(total_fees_collected, 0) + p_fee_amount,
            fees_breakdown = jsonb_set(
                COALESCE(fees_breakdown, '{"swap":0,"p2p":0,"withdraw":0,"unstake":0,"other":0}'::jsonb),
                ARRAY['swap'],
                to_jsonb(
                    COALESCE((fees_breakdown->>'swap')::numeric, 0) + p_fee_amount
                )
            )
        WHERE asset_symbol = p_to_asset;
    END IF;
END;
$function$
